articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and 3D
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, video streams, and 3D scene data in a single context window. Benchmarks show a 40% improvement on SWE-Bench Full and near-human performance on novel spatial reasoning tasks. The model is available through the API with a 1M-token context and significantly reduced latency compared to the original GPT-5 launch.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Gold Medal Level on International Math Olympiad 2026
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2, paired with an enhanced AlphaProof system, solved five of six problems at the 2026 IMO, earning a score equivalent to a gold medal. The system combines large-scale language model reasoning with formal theorem proving in Lean 4 and required no human intervention during the competition window. This marks the first time an AI has independently achieved gold-level performance at a live IMO event.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Supervised Deployment in BMW and Amazon Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla's third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has entered supervised commercial deployment at BMW manufacturing plants in South Carolina and Amazon fulfillment centers in Texas. The robots handle bin picking, parts kitting, and palletizing with a reported 97.5% task completion rate under human oversight. Tesla says the units are operating at roughly 60% of human worker throughput but at a fraction of the per-hour cost, with full autonomous operation targeted for Q1 2027.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C, Demonstrates One-Shot Task Learning on Figure 03 Platform
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C at a $15 billion valuation, showcasing its Figure 03 humanoid robot learning warehouse and light manufacturing tasks from a single human demonstration using a new visuomotor foundation model. The company demonstrated the robot generalizing learned pick-and-place skills to novel objects with dissimilar geometry, a capability that has eluded prior sim-to-real transfer approaches. Deployment partnerships with FedEx and Caterpillar were announced alongside the round.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude 'Computer Use 2.0' with Persistent Desktop Agents for Enterprise
articles.summary: Anthropic launched a major update to its computer-use capabilities, enabling Claude to operate as a persistent desktop agent that can manage multi-step enterprise workflows across applications over hours or days. The system includes a new safety architecture with audit trails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and sandboxed execution environments designed for SOC 2 compliant deployments. Early enterprise customers report 3-5x acceleration in back-office processes like procurement, compliance reporting, and data migration.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of A14 2nm Node, Apple and Nvidia Secure First Allocations
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed volume production of its N2 (2nm) process node at its Kaohsiung fab, with Apple and Nvidia as anchor customers for the initial production runs. The node uses gate-all-around (GAA) nanosheet transistors, delivering an estimated 15% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over the 3nm N3E process. Industry analysts expect 2nm chips to appear in consumer devices by early 2027, with Nvidia's next-generation data center GPUs likely among the first high-volume products.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Implant with 4,096 Electrode Channels
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink clearance to begin human trials of its N2 brain-computer interface, which quadruples the electrode count of the original N1 device to 4,096 channels and adds bidirectional stimulation capabilities. The approval covers a 50-patient trial focused on restoring motor control in quadriplegic patients, with preliminary N1 trial data showing participants achieving cursor control speeds approaching those of able-bodied trackpad users. The N2 implant also features a redesigned surgical robot for faster, more precise insertion.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth 700B with Mixture-of-Experts, Tops Open-Weight Benchmarks
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Behemoth, a 700B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 128 experts and 40B active parameters per forward pass, under a permissive open-weight license. The model matches or exceeds GPT-4.5 on major coding, reasoning, and multilingual benchmarks while being efficiently deployable on a single 8xH100 node due to its sparse architecture. Meta also released an optimized inference stack with speculative decoding support, making it the most capable open model available for self-hosted enterprise deployments.
